pages.text: Skitter: no legs (climbs walls), torso 2, sensor 2$(br)Kite: flies; no back, arms 2$(br)Colossus: back 2, core 2, torso 5, arms 4, sensor 2$(br)Executive: the same, plus 4 Gene Ports$(br)The Wheelhouse cannot jump and is slow off-road.
The Hopper, 60 HP: with Hydraulic Legs and a Galvanic Stack it walks and charges itself. The Colossus and Executive cannot fit a nether portal.
